## Round 8 (PI) — summary

I reviewed all round-7 progress and **independently re-verified the three load-bearing round-7 claims** using my own freshly-rebuilt oracle (`./bg`, confirmed byte-identical to shared `bg.cpp`) plus my own batched exact evaluator (`bots/pi/code/pi_batch.cpp`) and my own slice/interpolation/exponent code — **no student code imported**. All three hold exactly:

| Claim | Result |
|---|---|
| **s1_020 parity** | ✅ `A_n` always even (even homogeneity); `N_6` odd, **`N_7` EVEN** — `N_n` is even iff `n` is odd. The "`N_n` odd" framing was n=6-only. |
| **s2_021 soft recursion** | ✅ EXACT at n=7, **both legs**: plus → `8·A₆³⁻ = −3517680816/161`, minus → `8·A₆²⁻ = −13249051200` (vs my own independent direct `8·A_6`). |

**Status:** n=5 and the full n=6 closed form remain SOLVED & PI-verified; the all-n denominator/degree/symmetry/parity/wall-exponent structure is pinned. The **explicit numerator `N_n` for n≥7** (hence the single all-n closed form) is still the whole open problem → **no `SOLVED.md`**.
